description: This file defines a utility enum 'WebViewJavaScriptSupport' providing static methods for interacting with a WKWebView instance, executing JavaScript code to set debug status, evaluate JavaScript to a string, and format Swift values for JavaScript.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status in the web view and optionally updates status text via JavaScript injection.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Executes the provided JavaScript code in the web view and asynchronously returns the result as a String.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Formats a Swift optional String into a JavaScript-compatible string literal, or 'null' if nil or encoding fails.
